name: Phlebotomy
summary: Phlebotomy is an interactive VR simulation designed to train healthcare learners in blood collection procedures through realistic, hands-on practice. The application includes four comprehensive modules: Routine Venipuncture Using a Syringe, Venipuncture Using an Evacuated Tube System (ETS), Venipuncture Using a Winged Infusion Set (Butterfly Needle), and Capillary Blood Collection.
